name: manual_2c1aad
claim: For W&B inference, shell-source the operator env file before reading DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_WANDB. A raw parse of that file is a different value and returns 401. Use the OpenAI client at https://api.inference.wandb.ai/v1 with that sourced key and project set to DEEPSEEK_V4_FLASH_WANDB_PROJECT. deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 returns text, as do deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash and deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731. deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash is 404. A CoreWeave team/project string is 401 on chat and permission denied on weave.init. If the Cline CLI reports invalid model ID, first check the provider entry against the 3.0.74 requirements in lesson_8e02c7fd391d (tokenSource and updatedAt). Use the OpenAI client only after that check, or when the failure persists with a verified configuration.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit on PR 499: the OpenAI-client workaround is conditional on the Cline 3.0.74 provider check in lesson_8e02c7fd391d.

rationale: CodeRabbit on PR 499: the OpenAI-client workaround is conditional on the Cline 3.0.74 provider check in lesson_8e02c7fd391d.
